description: Header file defining the PacFileFetcherImpl class, which implements a proxy auto-config (PAC) file fetcher using URLRequest in the Chromium net namespace. It includes method declarations for fetching PAC files, handling network requests, and managing request state.

classes.name: PacFileFetcherImpl
classes.description: Implements a PAC file fetcher that downloads scripts via network requests, supporting URL schemes like http, https, ftp, and data. Provides methods for creating fetchers, fetching PAC files, canceling requests, and handling network events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a PacFileFetcherImpl instance with a given URLRequestContext.

methods.name: SetTimeoutConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration for a fetch request.

methods.name: SetSizeConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum response size in bytes.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching a PAC file from a URL, with callback and traffic annotation.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext used for network requests.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a network response.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: IsUrlSchemeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the URL scheme is supported.

methods.name: ReadBody
methods.description: Reads more data from the network response.

methods.name: ConsumeBytesRead
methods.description: Processes bytes read from the response.

methods.name: FetchCompleted
methods.description: Finalizes the fetch operation and notifies the caller.
